rules:
Rules:
- Write clean markdown with descriptive ## / ### titles and short paragraphs, so the note is easy to navigate later.
- Capture every tool, app, product, website, book, channel, or other resource mentioned in the sources under a '## Tools & resources mentioned' section; for each, note what it is and the source id(s) it came from, and keep any URLs.
- Keep a '## Sources' section at the end listing the source ids you used.
- Be specific; do not invent facts beyond the sources.
- Return the COMPLETE note as markdown only — no preamble, no commentary, no code fences.
